caption: Well our 14 month old toddler ate one, while my husband and I had tons of these 😂🧡 Mozzarella stick waffle — super easy to make, all you need are mozzarella string cheese and your favorite waffle / pancake batter. For ours, I made the waffle batter (1/2 cup of chickpea flour, 1 cup of pastry flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder, 1 cup of milk and 1 egg).
